mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees and overcast at City Hall. Tonight, we have a waxing crescent moon, and at 8:25 PM, keep your eyes on the northwest near the high school to see the space station traveling toward Madison. The overnight low will be 61 degrees with rain in the forecast.
The city is encouraging residents to sign up for the digital newsletter to stay connected with local government projects, program updates, and important city news.

Today is a busy day in Verona with the downtown farmers market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, live music at Paddy Mac's, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, you can catch more trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus and live music later this week at Bailey's Run.

In a report covering calls from August 31 through September 14, police noted that on September 5, they responded to reports of vehicles being pranked with cheese on their windshields, confirming it was part of a viral social media trend with no actual damage caused.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM, but please be aware that they are not serving a flavor of the day today as the restaurant is currently closed for a scheduled remodel.
